title: iPhone 16 Pro Max vs. Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra: 2025 Flagship Battle
content:
The battle for smartphone supremacy in 2025 comes down to the iPhone 16 Pro Max and the Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra. Both devices offer peak performance, incredible cameras, and advanced AI features.

Design and Display

The iPhone 16 Pro Max features a refined titanium design with a 6.9-inch display, while the S24 Ultra maintains its sharp, professional look with an integrated S Pen.

Performance

Apple A18 Pro chip vs. Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3. Both provide more power than most users will ever need.

Camera Comparison

iPhone 48MP main sensor vs. Samsung 200MP sensor. Both deliver professional-grade photography and video.
